windows.notes:
Duotone for Windows 5.8.8

New
- Duotone shows up in the Windows media controls (Win+A, lock screen, headphone buttons), with the cover and a progress bar.
- Profiles of people who aren't your friends show their listening stats, never what they listen to. You can hide yours in Edit profile › Privacy.
- Import music shows your Spotify account at the top. It's also in Settings.
- Updates are also checked when you come back to the app. Some future updates may be required.

Improved
- Artist pages show more albums.
- Fewer requests when you return to the app: stats and per-song settings load only what changed.

Fixed
- The 3D cover no longer keeps turning after a drag released outside it, and the lyrics stay clickable.
- The sound effect on the 3D cover starts without a click first.
- A song titled with another artist's name is credited to the right artist.

Please update: older versions will stop being supported.

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/win-v5.8.6...win-v5.8.8
